warning_source: International Institute for Counter-Terrorism (ICT), Reichman University — Prof. Boaz Ganor, Maj. Gen. (res.) Yitzhak Brik and project teams
recipient: Benjamin Netanyahu; Yoav Gallant; Herzi Halevi; senior NSC and military/security decision-makers
progress: Multi-year contemporaneous preparedness research described a concrete multi-front-war scenario: Hezbollah mass rocket/missile fire, Hamas/PIJ and other Iranian-aligned fronts joining, rapid pressure on active air defense, strikes on bases/infrastructure, home-front gaps and insufficient ground-force/readiness systems. ICT later officially confirmed that findings were presented in the months before Oct. 7 to many political and military-security decision-makers. Ganor said he made roughly 40 presentations and Netanyahu received the report; Brik separately named Netanyahu, Gallant, Halevi and NSC leaders. Medium confidence / Both / strongly documented receipt. Brik says Gallant and Halevi incorporated recommendations into work plans, so response is Partially acted.
gaps: Exact individual delivery dates and recipient-by-recipient contemporaneous distribution records remain unpublished. Brik's phrase 'a year before the war' is chronologically imprecise when paired with Gallant/Halevi tenure dates. Not a tactical prediction of the Oct. 7 Hamas attack.

warning_source: Ofer Shelah / INSS researcher, published by IDF Dado Center
recipient: Senior IDF/state decision-makers not proven as recipients
progress: Official IDF Dado Center publication argued that force-building and war preparation remained far from producing adequate ground-force mass and that too little had changed to meet the real challenges ahead, explicitly using the Yom Kippur force-preparation failure as the analytical frame.
gaps: Publication on an official IDF professional platform does not prove delivery to a named qualifying recipient. Shelah is a former opposition politician, but this item was produced in an INSS/professional research capacity; retain exclusion-boundary review and do not accept without recipient evidence.

warning_source: State Comptroller Matanyahu Englman / Office of the State Comptroller
recipient: Benjamin Netanyahu; Yoav Gallant; Herzi Halevi
progress: Lane-6 recovery rechecked the official 2025 release establishing that the July 2023 surprise northern-border audit and its serious findings were delivered in August 2023 to Netanyahu, Gallant and Halevi. Existing WARN-43 already captures this warning with High confidence; no duplicate created.
gaps: Official source confirms August delivery but not the exact 14 Aug date reported by Jerusalem Post. Keep later causal statements by the Comptroller separate from the prewar warning evidence.

warning_source: Brig. Gen. Amit Saar / IDF Military Intelligence Research Division
progress: Document-recovery pass rechecked the established March/July warning chain and the official/secondary record that four MI documents reached Netanyahu. Publicly accessible material continues to support a July warning but does not yet resolve whether newly surfaced references to a 23 Jul document are a separate warning, one of the four known documents, or a date correction to the previously reported 16 Jul event.
gaps: Do not create a new warning until document metadata or an authoritative chronology resolves the 16 Jul versus 23 Jul relationship and prevents double counting.
